name: WF-19 Maintenance & Monitoring v3 — Operations Control

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.agent_maintenance_runs
(run_id,operation,scope,operational_state,results,created_at)
VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5::jsonb,now())
ON CONFLICT(run_id) DO UPDATE SET operational_state=excluded.operational_state,
results=excluded.results
RETURNING run_id,operational_state;
